description:
Update this shop's profile: the name, bio, location and logo on its page, and the contact phone eno shares with a buyer inside its chat. Use it when the seller asks to rename the shop, rewrite its bio, or change its location, logo or phone.

Send only the fields to change; changes are saved at once, and text longer than the page shows is shortened, not refused. A phone number another shop uses is refused with `phone_taken`, and nothing is changed.

Returns `shop`, the saved profile with get_shop's fields.

avatarUrl.description: The shop's logo: an image URL already on eno's storage, e.g. from a listing's images. An empty string removes it; leave it out to keep it

bio.description: About the shop in a few sentences for its page: what it sells, how it serves buyers. An empty string clears it; leave it out to keep it

location.description: Where the shop is, as a district or area, e.g. "Thảo Điền, Thủ Đức". An empty string clears it; leave it out to keep it

name.description: The shop's public name, shown on its page and beside its listings. Leave it out to keep the current name

phone.description: The contact phone, a Vietnamese mobile such as 0901 234 567; eno shares it with a buyer only in chat, never on the page. Leave it out to keep it

name: update_shop

anyOf.description: The storefront this connection acts for: its public profile, trust standing and how many listings buyers can see

active_listings.description: How many of its listings buyers can see on the site now (on sale and checked by eno); the rest are sold, hidden, expired or waiting for eno's check, and analytics_summary counts them by status

avatar_url.description: The shop's logo as a full image URL, shown on its page and beside its listings, ready to display; null when it has none, which update_shop can set

bio.description: About the shop, as shown on its page; null when it has none, which update_shop can fill

id.description: The shop id, for your records only: every tool on this connection reads and changes this one shop, so no tool takes it

location.description: Where the shop is, as shown on its page; null when not set, which update_shop can fill

member_since.description: When the shop joined eno, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp; buyers see it on the shop's page as how long it has been selling here

name.description: The shop's public name as buyers see it on its page and beside each listing; use it when you speak of the shop. Change it with update_shop

phone.description: The shop's contact phone number, which eno shares with a buyer only inside its chat, never on the public page, so do not repeat it in anything public; null when not set

response_rate.description: The share of buyers' conversations the shop answers, in percent (0–100); it reads 100 until eno has measured enough conversations, so a new shop shows 100

trust_score.description: eno's trust score for the shop, from 0 to 150, higher meaning more trusted; below 60 the shop is restricted (see trust_tier). It changes with the shop's record, not through any tool here

trust_tier.description: The trust level that score falls in. restricted: below 60 or under a scam hold, and it cannot post new listings until it recovers. standard, trusted and exceptional: posting as normal, higher tiers more trusted

shop.description: The saved shop profile after the update, the same fields get_shop returns; null only if it could not be read back, and the change is saved either way

title: Update shop
